full_judgment: 2. Facts leading, to filing of this, civil appeal, in short, are that 9.27 acres of land including the case land measuring 4.28 acres in plot No.1 of the pre-emption application of Cadastral Survey (in short, C.S.) Khatian No.57 and 40 decimals of land of C.S. Khatian No.185 appertaining to a combine Jama of Revisional Survey (in short, R.S.) recorded in the said C.S. Khatian Nos.57 and 185 of Mouza Umarpoil and 5.84 acres of land including case land measuring 0.84 acres of land Plot No.2 of the said application appertained to a jama of R.S. recorded in C.S. Khatian No.49 of said Mouza Umarpoil. The lands of the said holdings were in ownership of Jahangir Sarker who died leaving two sons opposite party No.6, Jasimuddin Sarker and opposite party No.7, Nasiddin alias Nasiruddin Shah of the pre-emption case; the two daughters Ayesha Bibi @ Alna Bibi and Sahabi Bibi. Sahabi Bibi died leaving behind her husband, Masiruddin and son, the pre-emptor, Shaher Ali. Masiruddin died leaving behind his 2nd wife opposite party No.11, Amisa Khatoon and her sons opposite party Nos.8-10 of the pre-emption case and 1st wife's son, the pre-emptor.
